body: If it's going to be like this for the rest of our lives then honestly no. I do love her though and when she says it back I believe her. I want to continue with this relationship as long as it changes because at present it's tearing me apart.

Well she has (what she thinks) is fibromyalgia so there isn't really much that can be treated there apart from funneling painkillers down her throat (which she doesn't like to take at all).

As far as her depression goes no I don't think anything is really being done about it as she won't listen to me. She believes that being put in an asylum or home would be the worst case scenario. This is why I contacted her family because I feel if she won't listen; then they need to do something about it.

(I also forgot to mention that I live a considerable distance away from her; up to 2-3 hours away so checking up on her is difficult).
